items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: I knew him when I was a kid. You knew him? Yeah, yeah. He was an old timers. Well I used to play with him.

ctx.x: Where's Tom Albert? I guess came from this side of the river. Tom Albert. Yeah, he came.

Oh yeah, he came from down the low coast down there. I knew him when I was a kid. You knew him? Yeah, yeah. He was an old timers. Well I used to play with him. Oh you did? Yeah. You did too? Yeah, I used to play with him.
When you were still using that snare with one head? Still young.
